originality.rationale: Asymmetry and Minkowski centers are classical; the new assessed claim is the complete arbitrary-positive-dimensional FREE JOIN additivity law plus exact all-center factorization. Exact-claim and alias queries in published research records and public sources, and section-level scrutiny of three closely related primary PDFs, yielded no result that implies it without additional argument. Earlier pyramid (singleton factor), simplex, Minkowski sum, and generic robust-optimization results are not the claimed universal equivalence. Historical terminology remains a genuine residual uncertainty.

value.rationale: Answers the natural open-ended structural question of how Minkowski asymmetry and all its minimizers transform under free joins. Gives a dimension-independent asymmetry 2k−1 for joins of arbitrary centrally symmetric factors, and exact additive affine-dimension law for nonunique center sets. Applies simultaneously to arbitrary nonsymmetric smooth and polytopal factors and is not a table lookup, arbitrary slice, or renaming of a special-case pyramid calculation.
